domains.Gdpr: Cookie and privacy consent captured in the browser.
domains.Media: Video and file storage, transcoding and secure playback.
domains.Onboarding: First-run setup steps a manager completes to go live.
domains.TeacherPayout: Off-platform teacher payouts a manager records from the dashboard.

events.Onboarding.SetupBannerDismissed: Manager dismissed the first-run setup checklist.
events.Onboarding.SetupBannerShown: First-run setup checklist shown on the dashboard.
events.Onboarding.SetupStepOpened: Manager opened a first-run setup step from the dashboard banner.
events.TeacherPayout.Recorded: The manager saved a bank transfer to a teacher from the teacher money table.
events.TeacherPayout.TeacherAnswered: The teacher confirmed or rejected a recorded payout from the earnings page.
